data.one_liner: A customizable code text field supporting syntax highlighting and scrolling.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CodeField widget paired with a CodeController to parse and highlight text input according to a specified language or custom pattern/string maps. It supports vertical and horizontal scrolling, line numbers, and custom code modifiers.
use_when: You need to build a code editor inside your Flutter application
You want real-time syntax highlighting for various programming languages
avoid_when: You only need a standard single-line or multi-line text input without syntax highlighting
You require complex IDE features like full language servers and deep code analysis
strengths: Supports 189 built-in languages and 90 themes via flutter_highlight
Includes code modifiers for automatic indentation and tab management
Supports both pattern-based and string-based custom parsing rules
weaknesses: Autocomplete disabling on Android does not work yet
Limited to text input and syntax highlighting features rather than a full IDE
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally include a monospace font asset for proper code rendering.
